shared_elements: circular disc motif on the body/torso
stylized head with simplified facial features
justification: Both surfaces present highly schematic anthropomorphic imagery with a prominent circular disc placed on the torso/body area, and both use simplified, non-naturalistic renderings of human form. However, A is a single monolithic frontal figure with relief motifs (bands, spirals, disc) distributed over a body, while B is a multi-figure narrative scene with boats crewed by rows of stroke-crew marks, a figure holding a horizontal bar, and rows of small repeated signs — none of which have any counterpart in A.
